local s1 = "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/SteWasHere/3afa13fabfe76ef68f20ea360f186d2a/raw/loader_prod.lua"
s1 ..= "?t=" .. tostring(os.time())

local ok, result = pcall(function()
	return game:HttpGet(s1, true)
end)

if not ok then
	warn("[STE Project] HttpGet failded:", result)

	return
end
if not result or result == "" then
	warn("[STE Project] Script empty")

	return
end
local v4, v5 = loadstring(result)

if not v4 then
	warn("[STE Project] loadstring failded:", v5)

	return
end
v4()
